import subprocess,json
code="
import json,os,re,subprocess,stat,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
P=Path('/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/pink-iptv-https.conf')
out={'task':'VivoAPK residual PINK Nginx and unit hygiene audit','read_only':True,'changed':False}
def cmd(args,timeout=9):
  try:
    r=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
    return (r.returncode,r.stdout)
  except (OSError,subprocess.TimeoutExpired):return (-1,'')
out['nginx_syntax_ok']=cmd(['nginx','-t'])[0]==0
out['legacy_enabled_symlink']=P.is_symlink()
out['legacy_vhost_exists']=P.exists()
out['pink_project_absent']=not Path('/srv/projects/pink-iptv').exists()
if P.exists():
  t=P.read_text()
  out['legacy_mode']=oct(stat.S_IMODE(P.stat().st_mode))
  out['legacy_bytes']=len(t.encode())
  out['legacy_file_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(t.encode()).hexdigest()
  out['legacy_mentions_serveriptv_duckdns']=('serveriptv.duckdns.org' in t)
  out['legacy_mentions_vivoapk']=('Vivoapk' in t or 'vivoapk' in t)
  out['legacy_mentions_jellyfin']=('jellyfin' in t.lower())
  out['legacy_has_proxy_pass']='proxy_pass' in t
  out['legacy_serves_tls']='ssl_certificate' in t
  names=re.findall(r'\bserver_name\s+([^;]+);',t)
  out['server_name_count']=sum(len(s.split()) for s in names)
  out['legacy_server_names_anonymized']=[''.join('#' if c.isalnum() else c for c in s)[:80] for x in names for s in x.split()]
  try:
    resolved=P.resolve(strict=True)
    out['target_within_nginx_tree']=resolved.is_relative_to(Path('/etc/nginx').resolve())
    out['target_in_sites_available']=resolved.parent==Path('/etc/nginx/sites-available')
  except Exception:out['target_within_nginx_tree']=False
out['jellyfin_unit_active']=(cmd(['systemctl','is-active','jellyfin-pink.service'])[1].strip()=='active')
out['pink_backend_unit_active']=(cmd(['systemctl','is-active','pink-iptv-backend.service'])[1].strip()=='active')
out['pink_vpn_unit_active']=(cmd(['systemctl','is-active','pink-vpn.service'])[1].strip()=='active')
names=['serveriptv.duckdns.org','vivo-team.duckdns.org']
for name in names:
  out['legacy_serves_'+name.split('.')[0]]=P.exists() and name in P.read_text()
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
"
p=subprocess.run(['sudo','-n','/srv/projects/skill-universal/runtimes/python3.12/bin/python3.12','-c',code],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
